notes.title: Asteroids ++ 1.3.1 - Speed Utility Refactor and Player Weight Removal
notes.content: [h2]Overhauled the speed utility:[/h2][list][*][p]Speed utility is now available in casual difficulty, previously it was locked down due to the weight system[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUT[/b] speed no longer affects player speed, it now affects player bullets[/p][/*][*][p]What does that mean? Some weapons rely on player speed to deal even more damage, for instance, rockets, fireworks and mini rock pods deal damage the larger the impact is. Other bullets get other benefits, like the shotgun being able to reach further down the line.[/p][/*][*][p]With this change, the power star utility will be much more useful since you wont go spinning around in places and it is easier to memorize player movement and controls without dynamically changing.[/p][/*][*][p]This change also removes player weight functionality entirely from the game. It was annoying that you would never know what kind of player weight you had when you put a certain weapon, and it was getting increasingly harder to balance with more items, so it is removed![/p][/*][*][p]Dash ability and strafing now get a speed buff depending on speed utility, which was supposed to be a thing in the first place.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance issues[/h3][list][*][p]There was an performance issue where if many asteroids were to be on top of each other, a blend effect would kick in and it was possible for hundreds of asteroids to blend colors which would cause huge lag spikes, especially for yellow asteroids. With this change I hope to reduce lags so you can destroy even more asteroids at smooth framerates.[/p][/*][*][p]Let me know if this change has improved the performance[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other changes[/h3][list][*][p]Speed utility is now significantly cheaper[/p][/*][*][p]Shift no longer activates abilities, as that is now for player strafing[/p][/*][*][p]Repair kit shotgun boost nerfed by 33%, other weapons unchanged[/p][/*][/list][p]Also in the following updates I will continue to refactor some parts of the game to make the development a bit easier. Since the beginning I've got some bad code written down which does stagger development a bit, [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6KtzADIW0tg"]but even if it's not as bad[/url] I will try to improve some areas where I think the game can benefit.[/p]

notes.title: 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
notes.content: [h1]HAPPY FIRST YEAR ANNIVERSARY[/h1][p]Happy birthday Asteroids ++ ! The game was released on 20th June of 2024, how time flies doesn't it? Well it's time to reveal some next changes for the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/8a998e21862966f9b60190c7b629060215b528f7.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Breakdown[/h2][p]I am still seeing the player base enjoying and playing the game. I've been pushing the game to other platforms like gx.games where the game got jawdropping [b]70000 players[/b] playing it! And [b]10000 steam players[/b] have launched the game![/p][h2]4th Drop[/h2][p]I will start doing Planet Drops again, I want to make the planet drops to be a bit more consistent, because the first drop lasted maybe 2 weeks, the second around a month or two, and this one? 9 MONTHS![/p][p]Yeah, that's right, the third drop lasted since 22nd September! I think it is finally time to do something about that, so I will try to be consistent and release **every planet drop for every 4 months.** This way the players can know when to expect new campaigns, weapons, asteroids and big updates, while in between [/p][h2]1.3.0[/h2][p]I have been working here and there on the game, to be honest, I've been mostly on other projects, so I think I will shift some focus on the game again, here is what is coming up:[/p][h3]Teegarden Campaign[/h3][p]A campaign featuring 4 planets, with a new gimmick of 'disproportionate' planets, where you will face 3x4 planets, or 4x3. The campaign will feature Teegarden B, C and D, and the Teegarden Star, which is 5x5! It will cost 3.99€ as a DLC, but like always, you can buy planets or get planet drops to play the campaign for completely free![/p][h3]The Jovian Moons[/h3][p]A campaign featuring 6 planets, featuring Ganymede, Callisto, Io, Europa, Amalthea, Himalia. The campaign will cost 5.99€, but you can buy planets or gather planet drops for free.[/p][h3]New Weapon - Fireworks[/h3][p]Thought it would be fitting. Basically imagine a rocket except it explodes into a bigger explosion of smaller rockets! It will deal HUGE damage, but no homing capability, and it has limited range.[/p][h3]New Ability - Power Star[/h3][p]For a temporary time, turn all of your weapons and utilities to level 12, and hear epic music while at it![/p][p]The 1.3.0 update will come out when the 4th drop gets out.[/p][h2]1.3.1 and beyond:[/h2][h3]Game-based campaigns/music kits[/h3][p]I was thinking to do this for a while, where if you owned something on the steam library, you would get a campaign or a **music kit for free.** I'm going to look into it more and this will be a cross-game event.[/p][h3]Changeable music[/h3][p]Music during gameplay are based on what asteroids you face, but I will be looking to have players customize this feature.[/p][h3]Difficulty Change[/h3][p]I will be making a drastic change for difficulty. When going from planet to planet, you lose weapons and their levels based on difficulty, but I am thinking to change it up so that instead of losing weapons, the shop items get banned per planet based on seed. I think this is a more interesting approach rather than removing something from the player that they already bought.[/p][h3]Weekly planet difficulty[/h3][p]There are players playing and competing for a new record times in weekly planet, so I will do a small update for it. You will be able to change difficulties in weekly planet and you will get bonuses.[/p][h3]Common Drops[/h3][p]Music kits, asteroid drops, weapon drops! You name it! They are all coming[/p][h3]Ability/Utility Crafting[/h3][p]I plan to add abilities and utility items for drops, which can be used as discounts for the skill tree (1% per level), just like how weapons work at the moment.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, I will be hard working to get this out as fast as possible! Tomorrow is going to be a sale on the Asteroids ++ Soundtrack, Proxima Centauri and Kepler-90 campaigns. Have fun![/p]

notes.title: Asteroids ++ 1.2.9
notes.content:
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[b]Player[/b]
[list]
[*] 🚀 You can now thrust in Asteroids ++ 
[*] The player can now hold LCTRL (or hold LB button) to thrust to double speed, but changes controls and movement feels much like in classic asteroids. You can use strafing to damage or even destroy asteroids at a fast enough speed. 
[*] Thrusting will however use up ability power (faster speed = more ability power used). Be careful! Clones will use more ability power if you have many of them!
[*]This brand new feature [strike]will be for future [b]ship[/b] types[/strike]
[/list]

[b]Waves[/b]
[list]
[*] Each wave gives 100 ability power (even with super skip)
[/list]

[b]Nuke[/b]
[list]
[*] Nuke can now target UFOs (between medium and large asteroid priority, previously under small asteroids priority)
[*] Nuke now deals 1.5X damage at starting level (20 > 30 per frame on level 1, 32 > 42 on max level), this change does not affect the player's losing health being inside the nuclear explosion
[*] Mothership's pulse can reflect the nuke
[/list]

[b]Space Gifts[/b]
[list]
[*] Timestop can now slow down space gift movement
[/list]

[b]Hook[/b]
[list]
[*] The hook can now block enemy bullets at a cost of their carrying capacity being lowered because of it. The hook will have priority to chase after those bullets.
[*] Because of this change, the price dropped from 70 > 50
[/list]

[b]Ability Power[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability Power cannot go under 0 anymore.
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the engine to GM2024.13
[*] More of the game translated (more menu buttons and planets)
[*] Since the controls are starting to get a bit more complicated, I plan to release controls config for the 1.3.X, which is in the works.
[/list]

[h1][b]Update for Asteroids ++[/b][/h1]

Previously when trying to unlock DLCs, you could by either buying planets from the marketplace, or waiting for drops, but now I am adding another option and that is straight from the steam store! So...

[b]I am planning to release the following DLCs on steam:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/be465a21e97076cc4a13a0779b4b3d94eac969b1.jpg[/img]

Now these DLCs are the campaigns that already exist in the game, however buying these will immediately unlock them without the need to complete something or to own a planet (or set of planets) in your steam inventory. Even a download is not required, so all DLCs just get unlocked! A campaign would be unlocked with a purchase as an additional option.

For each DLC bought, users would get a gift based on a purchase (much like if you bought TCC or soundtracks), similar to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/2407300/detail/112/]Donation Gift[/url], but may be better depending on which DLC is bought.

There would be a bundle called 'Asteroids ++ | Super Edition' [i](working on the name)[/i] which includes all DLCs at a [b]25% discount[/b] (so currently at [b]11.99e[/b]), and this bundle will include all current and future DLCs!

And finally, all of the DLCs will receive discounts from time to time, unlike planets, there will be rotating discounts each month so be on the lookout! These discounts affect the bundle pricing as well.

[h3][b]But I already own some of the campaigns![/b][/h3]

If you already have the campaigns unlocked, [b]they will stay unlocked and everything is free if you own planets![/b] I am not removing access to anybody and never will, [b]forever![/b] After all it is your choice if you want to buy these DLCs! (and I would appreciate it because it really does help me a ton!) And you can still unlock them for free [strike](because time is money)
[/strike]
Expect these additions somewhere in February! If you have any questions, feel free to ask. Have fun!

[h3][b]Oh and also[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/8c9059a717c4f0daced21826983edd15f075f019.png[/img]

Thank you so much for over 100 reviews! It means a world to me that I can prove that this is the best Asteroids game yet! Totally not a biased claim. But you guys are awesome! While I know there are features/bugs that need to be addressed, you guys seem to really enjoy the game and I am very happy about it! Keep going with your love and support!

notes.content:

[h3][b]Asteroids drops changed:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Small Asteroid - 51.6% chance to drop instead of 20%
[*] Medium Asteroid - 25.8% chance to drop instead of 20%
[*] Large Asteroid - 12.9% chance to drop instead of 20%
[*] Huge Asteroid - 6.4% chance to drop instead of 20% (NOW RARE INSTEAD OF COMMON)
[*] Triplet Asteroid - 6.4% chance to drop instead of 20% (NOW RARE INSTEAD OF COMMON)
[*] Golden Variants - These asteroids are now 7.8X more rare to be dropped. (NOW VERY RARE INSTEAD OF RARE)
[/list]

Asteroids drop changes are made to balance asteroid crafting and make item trading more meaningful. It also naturally makes more sense to have bigger asteroids be rarer.

Finally, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408130/Asteroids__Soundtrack/]the official OST will also update to include new songs very soon.[/url]

[h3][b]Future Updates (1.2.X and 1.3)[/b][/h3]

[b]Infinite Achievements[/b] - I always hated the 'Do X amount of thing' achievements, which is why I (mostly) tried to avoid those achievements on Steam. My achievement design is generally unique for each weapon/ability/utility or progression based. Now I have an idea to include achievements in-game and the player can progress through infinite achievements where they can 'upgrade' achievement medals and gain higher rewards!

[b]Monthly Medals[/b] - I plan adding monthly medals, there would be a medal which can be upgraded to infinity and each upgrade costs more credits. (So for december it would be a christmas based medal). Each medal upgrade brings a permanent 1% buff (either shop discount, weapon buff, ability buff, utility buff, asteroids health, asteroids damage, specific asteroid type nerfs, skill tree buffs, etc) but costs more and more credits the more it is upgraded. A new medal would appear each month, however, if you upgraded a medal from the previous year, the levels would be saved so you wouldn't have to grind for upgrades again! Ironman mode will disable these buffs, and in weekly/daily levels ironman mode is on by default.

[b]Monthly Gifts[/b] - There would be a monthly gift which when opened would let you play a minigame and depending how well you did in a minigame the prize is determined based on how well you did. These would be obtainable through IAP (or special events). On average a player can earn 15000 credits, up to a max of 30000 if they play minigames perfectly (or 10000 minimum if they do it poorly). There would be a unique minigame for each month!

[b]Shop Discounts[/b] - I am thinking to make a discount system for the IAP shop, so occasionally there would be a sale on a specific item in the shop.

That's all, thanks for playing!

[*] Asteroids will no longer spawn other asteroids if they have max hp (with exception for bosses, for now...)

[h3][b]Machine Gun[/b][/h3]

Shotgun was supposed to be a weapon that acts similarly as the rifle and machine gun, so later levels will be cheaper

[*] Procedural Cost (40>25)
[/list]
[h3][b]Hook[/b][/h3]
Hook will get a semi-overhaul, it was too good at collecting coins and made players quickly rich, unbalancing the economy when reaching a high hook level.
[list]
[*] Max hooks that can be spawned on level 12 hook (12 > 4)
[*]Hook Damage (0.4 + hook level * 0.05 > 0.8 + hook level * 0.1)
[*] Hook Damage Cooldown (0.083s > 0.166s)
[*] Starting Cost (125>100) Procedural Cost (65>30)
[*] Fixed Hook EXP gain, I'll change how weapons gain EXP in a future update
[/list]
[h3][b]Dash[/b][/h3]
Nobody used dash, so I made it more accessible
[list]
[*] Starting Cost (75>50)
[/list]
[h3][b]Timestop[/b][/h3]
Timestop can be exploited in various ways and while I like seeing players use various strategies, it can be too good on higher levels
[list]
[*] Procedural Cost (70>80)
[/list]
[h3][b]Quad Damage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Procedural Cost (50>70)
[/list]
[h3][b]Repair Kit[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Procedural Cost (20>15)

notes.title: Asteroids ++ 1.1.5 - MULTI-SECTOR SELECT
notes.content:
[h1][b]Release 1.1.5[/b][/h1]

I would've easily called this 1.2.0, but I'm planning something much bigger, so 1.1.5 it is.
Ever had 'low attention span' playing this game? Beating Jupiter sectors 16 times sounds repetitive, which was a common complaint that it gets a bit stale after a while. So I decided to add something to counter that while adding strategic value.

[h2][b]Introducing Multi Sector Select![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/d44a01e55a4d20e45095fbdd081039218f7f516c.png[/img]

Multiselecting sector lets you battle multiple sectors at once! This also works with idle conquering, so you can idle conquer multiple sectors as well. There is no limit on what sectors you battle, [b]you can conquer the entire planet by selecting all sectors![/b]

The ultimate goal for this is to lower amount of playtime required to save the planet, but in return it makes the game harder and less rewards on average is given. Note that this feature is locked until players are at least level 15, this was intentional to not frustrate new players with information bombardment.

[h2][b]New Campaign - THE SUN[/b][/h2]

It's a campaign with a single planet, which is 6 x 6 size! Use multi sector to your advantage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/adab70d22e59c5c6b4860758860cc5f4bb17b496.png[/img]

You need to have the sun item in your inventory to play

[h2][b]Gifts[/b][/h2]

By having other Infiland games, Asteroids ++ OST, or simply donating, you will receive gifts for free! What could be inside? Who knows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/a7a0cfe921b382a85cbb44795ac1695fc383fb46.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Achievements[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]WOMBO COMBO[/b][/h3]
Beat 10 or more sectors at once
[h3][b]SUPER SKIP PAYOUT[/b][/h3]
Gather over rewarded 1000 $$$ for super skipping

[h3][b]Summary[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Added the sun campaign
[*] Mouse controls now save
[*] Added multi sector select
[*] Multi selecting will cause the battle room to be bigger
[*] Bosses will now properly spawn when super skipping
[*] Decreased logo size in the menu, causing better texture sorting
[*] Changed hud to work well with big sector rooms
[*] Added gifts for having infiland's stuff
[*] Fixed black player sprite in sandbox
[*] Added "scroll to view more" in skill tree due to players missing out on the scroll at the bottom

[*] Planet descriptions can now have colored text
[*] Added 2 new steam achievements
[*] Added back "receiving items" prompt
[*] Added "Planet Collection" menu, which is locked out for now
[*] Fixed bug where weapons were reset when going to settings ingame
[*] Debug stats are now viewable with F1 instead of F
[*] Improved visibility of wave counts after wave 25
[/list]

Recently there has been an increase of the "player count" where the game jumped from the highest 24 player count up to 4000! However this looks like a bot problem. Seems like bots run the game every 2 hours to try to get item drops, usually weekly planets and sell them on the market. This update attempts to fix this issue of bots, the game now has an algorithm which checks if you are a legit player playing. This algorithm is not going to be explained.

[h3][b]Features/Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Engine updated to from GM 2024.4 to 2024.6, which brings more stability to the core of the game
[*] Attempt to "fix" the bot problem
[*] Player Count EXP multiplier bonus decreased
[/list]

I won't ban bots, as it's impossible to ban 4000 individual accounts, let alone make the anticheat try to ban people, which could lead problems in banning legit players, so my goal is to make users get drops but just make it HARDER FOR BOTS to get drops. Enjoy the update

notes.title: ASTEROIDS ++ WILL RELEASE THIS JULY
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hola![/b][/h2]
I am extremely excited to announce that Asteroids ++, my next upcoming game is coming up on [b]July 2024.[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2407300/Asteroids/]Be sure to wishlist the game to be the very first players to try the game out![/url]

[h1]T H E   Y E A R   I S   2 4 5 0[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/9c332073e2564d958fa2714d9881a8f9813c52ab.png[/img]

[i][u]Humanity has expanded their technology and improved in Rocketry. There was nothing out of the ordinary until disaster struck!

A moon one light year away exploded and has spread asteroids all over our solar system, this is where YOU come in!

You play as one of the captains who will control one of the spaceships! Go from planet to planet and get rid of the Asteroids![/u][/i]

[h1]What to expect?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/af2b2c8025eadd7c86e21a35ac84088486d6f58b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Asteroids ++ is the best Asteroids clone you will ever play in your life.[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] The game currently has 12 weapons, 6 abilities and 6 utilities, each will a skill tree that the player can use to their advantage to beat those pesky asteroids! 
[*] Conquer and beat sectors to gain control and save planets in your solar system!
[*] The game currently has two campaigns, Main Game and Pluto where players can save various planets and gather trophies! More will be added throughout updates!
[*] The game has steam achievements that the player can try and get by beating planets in campaigns
[*] The game has statistics that track the player, as well as leaderboards of how much money players have
[*] The game has an economy with droppable items with their own rarities and value
[*] [strike]The game has... lore??[/strike]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/168feb010c4de87e8463f79fa3ef1c3b9d41e50c.png[/img]
[h2][b]What is coming?[/b][/h2]
During the livespan of the game I expect to add more content and features, such as:
[list]
[*] Customizable Weapons (Adjust your weapon to your liking, more money spent = more powerful weapon)
[*] Endless Run (Compete in a leaderboard with other people)
[*] Campaign Editor (Make your own levels, planets and scenarios!)
[*] Steam Workshop Support
[*] Controller Support
[*] Local Co-OP [strike](And maybe online multiplayer)[/strike]
[/list]

Keep in mind, this is a game that is [b]free to play![/b] So there will be upcoming DLCs (mainly OST) that support me to continue making this game.

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]
